snippet.title: Horror Tolerance Test Full Game Challenge Can You Handle the Fear? (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
Dive into the chilling experience of HorrorToleranceTest, a unique indie horror game that adapts to your fear level. This full gameplay walkthrough captures every unsettling moment across three horror challenges:

🎯 What’s Included:

Complete run of all three mini-games: Surprise Horror, Hide Horror, and Escape Horror

The pre-test that gauges your “judgment,” “memory,” and “observation” to dynamically scale horror difficulty

Full horror experience with no commentary — just raw fear

Developed by うさうさはっぴーげーむず and released on August 20, 2025, this game uniquely diagnoses how well you handle different types of horror. Are you brave enough to face it all?

🔔 Make sure to subscribe https://www.youtube.com/@ZlXgames?sub_confirmation=1
